questions.question: Starting from the blue ball hopper with the solved board configuration, describe the complete path of the first blue ball.
questions.answer: The first blue ball drops from (2, -1), rolls onto ramp_right at (3, 0), then ramp_right at (4, 1), then crossover at (5, 2), then ramp_right at (6, 3), then ramp_left at (7, 4), then ramp_right at (6, 5), then ramp_left at (7, 6), then ramp_right at (6, 7), then ramp_left at (7, 8), then ramp_right at (6, 9), and is caught at the right exit.

questions.question: What is the output pattern after running the machine?
questions.answer: 16 balls reach an exit in the order: blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left, blue exits right, red exits left. 8 exit left, 8 exit right, 0 are intercepted.

questions.question: Explain how the alternating pattern is achieved in this puzzle.
questions.answer: Blue balls are led to the right lever via the crossover path, releasing red balls. Those red balls must cross back to the left lever using additional ramps, releasing more blue balls. This creates the alternating loop.
